title: In Praise of Scribes
scope_note: This pilot compares archival English from each opening title through the final ownership note. Model headers and later digitization metadata are outside scope; page and segment labels are ignored by token alignment. Sixteen selected cases receive provisional semantic triage; three equivalent-wording controls are retained. This is not an exhaustive philological review. The comparison is retained as the frozen pre-correction snapshot; local correction resolutions are shown separately.
